sentences.text: None appeared to press this revision.
In the circumstances, I myself have perused the record.
2. This criminal revision under Section 397/401 Cr.P.C., has been filed aggrieved by the judgments and orders dated 01.06.1998 and 17.08.1999.

The Chief Judicial Magistrate, Mahoba vide order dated 01.06.1998 convicted revisionist and sentenced him to undergo six months rigorous imprisonment with fine of Rs. 1000/- under Section 7(I)/16(II) of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act and three months rigorous imprisonment with fine of Rs. 500/- under Section7(III)/ 16(II) of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act.

Thereagainst, revisionists preferred Criminal Appeal No. 11 of 1998 and Appellate Court vide order dated 17.08.1999 dismissed appeal and confirmed order of conviction and sentence passed by Trial Court.
Being aggrieved the revisionist preferred present revision.
